newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Baoshi to launch A share offer on Sept 11.
newsitem.headline: Baoshi to launch A share offer on Sept 11.

text.p: Hebei-based TV tubes maker Shijiazhuang Baoshi Electronic Glass Co Ltd said on Thursday it would issue 26.20 million class A shares on September 11.
The offer, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been priced at 6.28 yuan per share, a company spokesman told the official China Securities Bulletin.
Shanghai Shenyin & Wanguo Securities is main underwriter.
Baoshi also had approval from the regulator to list 3.80 million staff shares, at 1.50 yuan a share in 1992, along with the class A stock on the south China bourse, the spokesman said.
The firm, which already has 100 million B shares listed in Shenzhen, planned to use the proceeds for manufacturing colour television tubes.

Baoshi said in an interim report for 1996 that under international accounting standards, it had unaudited net earnings of 65.66 million yuan in the first half of 1996, down 20.7 percent from the year-earlier level of 82.75 million.
Most of Baoshi's products are currently sold in rural China, it said. It planned to export black-and-white television tubes to developing countries such as Egypt, India and Pakistan.
